record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Given integers p > q ≥ 2 and m,n ∈ ℕ, determine the maximum number of 2π-periodic limit cycles of Abel-type equations ẋ = A_m(t)x^p + B_n(t)x^q, where A_m and B_n are 2π-trigonometric polynomials of degrees m and n, respectively.

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Given two integer numbers p > q≥2, and m,n ∈N, ﬁnd the maximum number of 2πperiodic limit cycles for next family of Abel type diﬀerential equations dx/dt =Am(t)xp +Bn(t)xq, whereAm and Bn are 2π-trigonometric polynomials with respective degrees m and n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p > q \geq 2$ be integers and let $m, n \in \mathbb{N}$. Consider the family of generalized Abel-type ordinary differential equations
$$\frac{dx}{dt} = A_m(t)\,x^p + B_n(t)\,x^q,$$
where $A_m(t)$ and $B_n(t)$ are real-valued $2\pi$-periodic trigonometric polynomials in $t$ of degrees exactly $m$ and $n$, respectively (i.e., each is a finite linear combination of $1, \cos(kt), \sin(kt)$ for $1 \leq k \leq m$ or $1 \leq k \leq n$). A $2\pi$-periodic limit cycle is an isolated $2\pi$-periodic solution $x(t)$ of this equation.

Determine the maximum possible number $H_{p,q}(m,n)$ of $2\pi$-periodic limit cycles, taken over all choices of trigonometric polynomial coefficients $A_m$ and $B_n$ of the prescribed degrees.
artifact.category_tag: Abel differential equations and limit cycles
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is widely regarded as open. Even for the classical case p=3, q=2, only lower bounds (e.g., H_{3,2}(n,m) ≥ 2(n+m)−1) and partial results (such as bounds for linear trigonometric coefficients) are known. The general question is closely tied to the unresolved Smale–Pugh problem on uniform bounds for limit cycles.

status_evidence.title: Maximum number of limit cycles for Abel equation having coefficients with linear trigonometric functions
status_evidence.snippet: For the classical Abel equation with linear trigonometric coefficients, the maximum number of limit cycles is shown to be three.
status_evidence.claim: Only special low-degree subcases of the family have known sharp bounds.

status_evidence.title: On the Number of Limit Cycles in Generalized Abel Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounds on the number of limit cycles of generalized Abel equations dx/dθ = A(θ)x^p + B(θ)x^q.
status_evidence.claim: Determining H_{p,q}(m,n) for general p,q,m,n remains an active research problem with only partial bounds known.

status_evidence.title: Rational solutions and limit cycles of polynomial and trigonometric Abel equations
status_evidence.snippet: Provides lower bounds such as H_{3,2}(n,m) ≥ 2(n+m)-1 for the classical Abel case.
status_evidence.claim: Lower bounds exist but no general formula for the maximum is established.
